t: How to Buy a House | First-Time Home Buyer Class
s: July 15, 2025 - For most of us, we were never taught when or how to get the process started. But owning your own home and building wealth through real estate can be life-changing. Sign up for our free “How to Buy a House” class in your city where we break down the process in a pressure free, digestible format.

t: First-time home buyers classes: A guide | Rocket Mortgage
s: June 3, 2025 - If you’re not sure how to get started as a home buyer, take a look at the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development’s list of approved courses. Your lender or real estate agent also may be able to point you toward a first-time home buyers course. If you want to access the course when it works for you, you should have no trouble finding and signing up for an online class.

t: What Is A Homebuyer Education Course? | Bankrate
s: April 25, 2025 - A first-time homebuyer class aims to make sure you’re ready for the commitment by helping you learn about the entire process of buying and owning a home.

t: r/FirstTimeHomeBuyer on Reddit: Does anyone have an recommendations on classes about mortgages and buying a house?
Homebuying 101 Class - Portland Housing Center
s: August 30, 2011 - This 8-hour, HUD-certified class will show you what to expect in the home-buying process, including shopping for a loan, special programs for first-time homebuyers, the house search, inspecting and insuring your home, and maintaining and protecting your investment.

t: First Time Home Buyer Classes | Housing & Education Alliance
s: December 12, 2024 - The Housing & Education Alliance, Inc. certifies Home Buyers attendance at a live, classroom instructor led class. Participants will learn the fundamentals of the home buying process.

t: HomeView Homeownership Education Course | Fannie Mae
s: HomeView is a comprehensive homebuying course that provides education for homeownership through courses on mortgage products.

t: Classes and Events
s: Buying or selling a home can be complicated, and Redfin is here to help! Join us for a free class to learn how to navigate the process from start to finish while enjoying food and drinks on us. Or, if you prefer to learn from the comfort of your home or office, sign up for one of our webinars instead!

t: How to Buy A House Class — Waller House Group | Austin Real Estate | Compass
s: Want to buy a house but have no idea where to start? Join us for a free in-person class in Austin where we break down the home-buying process and empower you to take the leap. No matter where you're at in the process, you're welcome here!

t: First-Time Home Buyer Class: Why Take It? - NerdWallet
s: December 16, 2025 - The U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) has a nationwide network of housing counseling agencies that provide first-time home buyer workshops, along with one-on-one counseling and other services. Classes are also offered by other providers, including for-profit companies, nonprofits and community organizations.

t: Homebuyer Education Courses: Are They Worth the Time?
s: November 15, 2021 - Also, some lenders prefer that their buyers take such a course to help them understand what will be required as they go through the steps of buying their first home. The class usually takes homeowners on a journey of the home-buying process, everything to know from budgeting to selecting a home to making an offer and closing.

t: Home buyers class - Consumer Credit
s: April 3, 2020 - Classes offer special advice for first time buyers with information on everything from credit scores, mortgage applications, choosing the right loan and special programs available to first time buyers. When you finish a comprehensive home buyers class, you’ll enter the home purchase process with the confidence to make smart decisions to help you achieve your financial goals.

t: Homebuyer Education | RIHousing
s: October 27, 2025 - RIHousing’s Homebuyer Education Classes help prospective homebuyers understand the process of buying and keeping a home.

t: Homebuyer Education – HomeSight
s: Homebuying can be overwhelming for first-time buyers. Not for HomeSight buyers! We’ll prepare you for every step in the homebuying journey. HomeSight offers free personal financial counseling and free homebuying classes.

t: Boston Home Center Classes | Boston.gov
s: November 12, 2025 - Homebuying is a 90-minute seminar which gives an overview of what to expect during the homebuying process. It’s the perfect class to take to prepare yourself for Homebuyer 101.

t: Homebuyer Education Class | Neighbor to Neighbor
s: December 4, 2025 - Whether you are just starting to explore the option of homeownership or you are about to close, Neighbor to Neighbor’s Homebuyer Education class provides a wide range of information about the home purchase process. Thanks to sponsor support, our HUD and CHFA-approved class is offered for free to everyone, and it fulfills the education requirements for many programs, including LHOP, USDA, and CHFA.

t: Find a Homebuyer Class - Massachusetts Housing Partnership
s: These Massachusetts homebuyer education providers offer classes that help guide you down your path to homeownership, and taking one of these classes before you buy is required to get a ONE Mortgage. Contact a provider for details and to sign up.

t: Homebuyer Education Classes – Community Partners for Affordable Housing
s: Navigating the home buying process can be confusing. CPAH’s 4-hour homebuyer education class will get you ready for the complex home buying process and help you make the best choices for your household.

t: Homebuyer Education
s: It’s never too early to prepare to buy a home, and we have resources to help you get started. ... We recommend you take a homebuyer education class.
